# Frozen V1 background-regression baseline

Test-only checkpoint before V2 Core or renderer implementation. The frozen ABI
mirror comes from immutable `44fb63f5` public headers. It checks sizes, alignments,
member offsets, enum values and selected function/callback signatures in strict
C11 through both selective distribution headers and the declaration-only umbrella.
It does not freeze every CUI public function or every unrelated event/binding ABI.
The mirror is independent source: do not regenerate it to accept an ABI change.
No fixture function is a public CUI symbol.

`commands_pixels.golden` is captured from existing immutable pre-V2 archives,
not generated from future production code under test. See `provenance.json` for
source/library/compiler/fixture hashes and exact capture/verification commands.
Keep those original archives separate from the mutable build outputs. The capture
switch is for provenance-controlled capture ONLY; CI runs normal comparison.
Never refresh expected output after a V2 implementation simply because it differs.

Twenty-four cases are eight scenes at three sizes/fractional offsets/opacities:
plain boxes/borders, mixed DROP+INSET/outline, solid underlay/overflow clipping,
bitmap underlay/image/mesh, local/deferred prepaint with copied text, detached
portal inside a clip, paragraph gradient/spans with copied payloads, and late named
shadow plus anonymous underlay. A deterministic measurement callback avoids fonts
and platform shaping. Every prepaint callback must run exactly once.

`C` records contain exact normalized ACTIVE fields in command order and pointed-to
text/stop/span/vertex/pixel bytes. They contain no pointer addresses, padding,
inactive payloads or bitmap row-padding bytes. Floating point uses binary32 hex
bits with signed zero canonicalized; these target assumptions are asserted.
Colors/identities/counts use explicit integer text, including 64-bit revisions.
The normalizer is deliberately not a raw struct dump or an ownership claim.

`P` records losslessly run-length encode every software RGBA pixel in row-major
order; they are not image hashes or images regenerated by a newer implementation.
TEXT commands are excluded from software painting because the renderer has no
font. Their full bytes/style/source/spans/gradient are covered independently by
`C` records. There is NO glyph-raster, native-GPU, browser or full-text-rendering
parity claim. Normal test comparison reports the first differing canonical byte.
No tests open desktop windows; run native CTest through `scripts/test_local.py`.

Validation of this checkpoint uses preserved old archives without rebuilding Core.
The normal comparison target is also wired into CTest for integration builds;
that separately rebuilt current-library execution must pass before V2 production.
